title: Pay the seafarers compensation levy when it is declared
what: When the Minister has declared it, a levy is imposed on seafarer berths on prescribed ships to fund the Seacare scheme.

laws.title: Seafarers Rehabilitation and Compensation Levy Act 1992

sources.title: Seafarers Rehabilitation and Compensation Levy Act 1992
sources.quote: 4 Imposition of levy If the Minister has made a declaration under section 100 of the Seafarers Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 1992, levy is imposed on seafarer berths on prescribed ships.

administration.who: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations

sources.title: Administrative Arrangements Order

reach.condition: if it operates prescribed ships while a declaration under s 100 of the Seafarers Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 1992 is in force
